name: Figo Fago
overview: Ryszard Gaj and Damian Palocion are the pride of the capital’s police precinct, hardened by tough cases and equally challenging romances. No one charges into action like they do, no one backs up their partner so fiercely, and with nerves of steel and well-toned physiques, they use their own investigative methods and signature yo-yo techniques to wage a fierce war on lawlessness and intolerance.
